text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Large-scale celebrations to mark President Saddam Hussein's birthday.
- Iraqi helicopters fly pilgrims throughout Iraq.
- Yemen accuses Saudi Arabia of blocking its legislative elections.
- New ship loaded with wheat anchors at Umm Qasr.
- Oil minister continues meeting with Italian officials.
- New convoy of foodstuffs on its way to Iraq from France.
- Trade Ministry decides to lower prices of flour as part of Saddam birthday celebrations.
- U.S. fails again to issue anti-Iraq statement at U.N. sanctions committee.
- U.N.'s General Assembly criticises Israeli housing policy in occupied Jerusalem.
- Revolutionary Command Council Vice-Chairman Izzat Ibrahim reviews preparations for this year's harvest.
- Campaign to keep Baghdad clean and tidy.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
